subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Is the supplied test and CI evidence sufficient to merge this Signal behavior fix without an observed after-fix Signal runtime transcript or bridge log?
rationale: The PR explicitly lacks a linked Signal account and contains no real runtime artifact, while the protected `maintainer` label requires human handling of the proof gate.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Request a redacted Signal send/receive or bridge-log artifact that visibly shows the debounced agent input contains real line breaks before merge.

options.title: Accept focused proof
options.body: A responsible reviewer may waive live Signal proof if the focused regression assertions and completed channel checks are accepted as sufficient for this narrowly scoped separator correction.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted Signal send/receive or bridge-log artifact that visibly shows the debounced agent input contains real line breaks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and authored the current implementation, so they are the clearest available contact to supply or explain proof.
